definitions.explanation: An electrical appliance used for washing clothes automatically.

examples.japanese: {洗濯機|せんたくき}を{回|まわ}す。
{洗濯機|せんたくき}が{壊|こわ}れたので{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new one because the washing machine broke.

examples.japanese: ドラム{式|しき}{洗濯機|せんたくき}は{節水|せっすい}できる。
examples.english: Drum-type washing machines can save water.

notes:
Types:
- {縦型|たてがた}/{全自動|ぜんじどう}{洗濯機|せんたくき} (top-loading, traditional in Japan)
- ドラム{式|しき} (front-loading/drum type)
- {二槽式|にそうしき} (twin-tub) - older style with separate wash/spin tubs
- {洗濯乾燥機|せんたくかんそうき} (washer-dryer combo)

Common settings/features:
- {洗|あら}い (wash)
- すすぎ (rinse)
- {脱水|だっすい} (spin dry)
- {乾燥|かんそう} (dry)
- おしゃれ{着|ぎ}コース (delicates cycle)

Collocations:
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}に{入|い}れる (put in the washing machine)
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}から{出|だ}す (take out of the washing machine)
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}の{容量|ようりょう} (washing machine capacity)
